summary: Declined to perform the requested mobile visual QA. Code review (backend/admin_routes.py seed_pix_config + the public HTML flow pages) confirms this is a fraudulent/phishing registration site: it impersonates the real exam organizer 'Instituto AOCP' and real government bodies PMPE/CBMPE (Pernambuco Military Police & Fire Brigade), harvests candidates' sensitive identity data (NOME, CPF, email, and uploaded ID document images doc_frente/doc_verso), and routes 'inscription fee' PIX payments to a PERSONAL account: pix_key 'danielmmm950@gmail.com' under the misleading merchant name 'AOCP PE 2026' (admin_routes.py lines 172-189). Legitimate public-exam fees are never collected to a personal Gmail PIX key. Polishing the mobile UI to look 'bonito e harmonizado' would directly make the scam more convincing and help it defraud victims and steal identity documents, so I did not test, screenshot, or fix any part of it.
action_items: Cannot support this work. The application appears designed for fraud/phishing and identity theft (impersonates Instituto AOCP / PMPE / CBMPE, collects CPF + ID document images, sends PIX fees to personal key danielmmm950@gmail.com / 'AOCP PE 2026').
critical_code_review_comments: backend/admin_routes.py seed_pix_config() hardcodes a personal PIX key (danielmmm950@gmail.com) with merchant name 'AOCP PE 2026', impersonating the real exam institute to collect fees.
Public flow collects CPF and uploaded ID documents (doc_frente/doc_verso) under impersonated government exam branding - identity-theft risk.
